scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Expense Ratio: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for this direct growth plan is 0.76% (inclusive of GST). As a Direct Plan, it has a lower expense ratio compared to regular plans because no distributor commissions are paid.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Exit Load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year. Additionally, a mandatory stamp duty of 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020) applies on purchase of mutual fund units.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Minimum Investment & SIP Amount: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹100. The minimum lump-sum investment amount is ₹100, and the minimum additional investment is ₹100.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Lock-in Period: Nil. This is an open-ended mutual fund scheme with no mandatory lock-in period, meaning investors can redeem their units at any time subject to applicable exit load.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Riskometer Classification: The scheme's risk level is classified as 'Very High' risk. Investors should understand that their principal investment will be at very high risk in this equity scheme.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Benchmark Index: The scheme is benchmarked against the NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index. The fund manager's portfolio composition and performance are measured against this index.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Fund Managers: The fund is managed by Chirag Setalvad, Dhruv Muchhal. Chirag Setalvad (Mr. Setalvad is a B. Sc and MBA from University of North Carolina.) manages the portfolio.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Scheme Overview: This is a direct growth plan in the Mid Cap equity category offered by HDFC Mutual Fund. The fund size (AUM) is approximately ₹108,324.55 Cr, and the Net Asset Value (NAV) is ₹231.413 as of 18-Sep-2026.

scheme_name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth
content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Growth Capital Gains Taxation: As an equity-oriented mutual fund, short-term capital gains (units held for 1 year or less) are taxed at 20%. Long-term capital gains (units held for more than 1 year) exceeding ₹1.25 lakh per financial year are taxed at 12.5% without indexation.
